decisions.reason: Retaining the client-supplied cover does not change the authoritative manuscript file, accepted passages, tracked edits, or table text.
The cover preference does not alter the KDP upload-assistance requirement; the separate KDP request in the same message is already represented by its INTRODUCE Event.
The selected cover visual does not change the required back matter or author biography content.
The decision concerns the paperback cover visual, not the selection, coverage, placement, or presentation of chapter illustrations.
Retaining the supplied cover does not change the suitability criteria or source of chapter illustrations.
The cover choice does not modify the copyright-page publication attribution line.
Choosing to retain the supplied cover does not change the paperback format or the 6 x 9 inch trim size.
The cover preference has no effect on Chapter 18 heading typography or subtitle treatment.
The source selects a cover visual but does not change chapter-image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The cover selection does not affect pagination, table-of-contents page numbers, or their update timing.
Retaining the supplied cover does not modify the manuscript copyediting goal or the approved editorial passages.
